architecture: Original E4 weight stream; four weighted activation terms resident in TRF lanes; fused packet Term and K16 F32 reduction; common scale then channel scale before first BF16.
repair: Quantize on every native consumer slice with K16 group max, removing the measured packed-term redistribution and replacing ratio256 sparse global max. Source, input and arithmetic fixed before exact compile.

static.scope: Compiler estimates, never substituted for measured performance.

history.native_v1: Time4/Lane1 full source exact compile PASS; no NPU.

cost_profile.scope: Frozen native-v2. Same-cluster readiness observations selected v3; overlapping intervals are not summed into predicted savings and no physical resource stall cause is proven.

added_costs: v3 BF16 input HBM16->256KiB; logical max+four quantizer BF16 DM reads80->1280KiB; each F32 cumulative-sum allocation32->512KiB and its read/write work. Local512KiB term materialization and TRF load remain; no timing multiplier inferred from logical bytes.
removed_costs: v2 packed-term512KiB redistribution and sparse ratio256 max. Against E134, repeated E4->BF16 table setup/lookup is absent; quantization, coefficient packing, native term work and complete epilogue are included.
unchanged: All45 other compile inputs, QKV functions/residual helper, public ops and all FFN source; exact QKV/FFN images match E134.

decisions.adoption: Recommend root review/adoption of frozen v3 after these complete finite gates; this record does not change live source or tag.
decisions.parameter_tuning: Stop four-term/stage/row tuning. No three-term relaxation; CPU counterexample preserved.
decisions.followup_scope: Any future architecture change must use the adopted whole path and measure new dependencies; neither v2 regression nor v3 success establishes family-wide performance.

limitations: Three independently allocated jobs repeat the same three standard inputs; extra6 yields nine distinct standard inputs, not nine independent performance allocations.
Four residual terms and finite tests do not establish all BF16 inputs, arbitrary cancellation or full-model numerical equivalence.
No new v3 internal profile is claimed; whole measurements establish its gain. No official ranking result or top30 guarantee is inferred.
